newsitem.title: USA: Canada propane stocks down 13.8 percent in month.
newsitem.headline: Canada propane stocks down 13.8 percent in month.

text.p: Canadian inventories of propane fell in October by about 14 percent to 9.62 million cubic meters but were still well above year-ago levels, according to National Energy Board data.
The report, released Wednesday, also said normal butane stocks fell almost 8 percent to 3.45 million cubic meters. Stocks are 0.66 percent below year-ago levels.
In the Sarnia hub of eastern Canada, propane inventories dipped 0.06 percent in November to 6.82 million cubic meters, or 11.8 percent above last November.
Normal butane in the region fell 7.72 percent in the month but were 10.2 percent above last year, said the report.
In the Edmonton hub of western Canada, propane inventories fell 35.3 percent, standing at 24.7 percent below year-ago levels.
